intel.title: [CISA KEV] Ivanti Connect Secure - Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-104935
廠商: Ivanti
產品: Connect Secure
漏洞名稱: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
說明: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-16
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure 存在身分驗證繞過漏洞（CVE-2026-104935），遠端未授權攻擊者可利用此漏洞執行任意命令。該漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV 且有活躍攻擊風險，惟經盤點公司資產清冊中並無使用此產品。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft Windows - Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-96951
廠商: Microsoft
產品: Windows
漏洞名稱: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-16
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-US/vulnerability/CVE-2026-96951 ; BOD 26-04: BOD 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk | CISA ; Forensics Triage Requirements: BOD 26-04: Implementation Guidance for Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk | CISA ;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-96951

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 已將微軟 Windows Shell 命令注入漏洞（CVE-2026-96951）列入已知利用清單，攻擊者可透過網路繞過安全機制並執行命令。由於公司資產清冊包含 Windows Server 2019 與 AD 主機等 Windows 系統資產，若遭利用將造成嚴重的系統控制權失竊風險。
analysis.recommendation: 請資安與 MIS 團隊（RR40）依微軟官方安全指南儘速為 Windows Server 2019、AD 主機及 Windows 端點設備安裝修補程式，並依 CISA BOD 26-04 規範於 2026 年 10 月 16 日前完成對外曝險資產之風險評估與修補作業。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Windows Server 2019
資訊設備-桌上型電腦/筆記型電腦
